title: Tilted OpenStreetMap with zero-drift HTML markers and PNG export
blurb: A tilted 3D OpenStreetMap canvas with extruded landmark towers and four live HTML place cards. Drag to pan, rotate or pitch the map, tab across pins, toggle 3D building occlusion, and export a single PNG holding both map tiles and DOM cards.
question: Can a tilted 3D OpenStreetMap canvas render live interactive, keyboard-accessible HTML place cards with zero pan/zoom drift, 3D landmark depth occlusion, and one-click PNG export that includes both map tiles and DOM overlays?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context compositing cached OpenStreetMap tiles, extruded 3D landmark buildings and four drawable HTML place cards with depth testing, keyboard Tab focus tracking and tap-triggered PNG export. Live browser verification is not run yet.
